interpretations: Count rentals for each film rating by joining rentals through inventory to films. Keep ratings whose rental count is strictly above the mean rental count across all ratings, then return one row containing the mean count of those ratings and the mean of their counts minus the overall mean, without rounding
queries:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS mean_rental_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(rc.rental_count) AS mean_count,
  AVG(rc.rental_count - o.mean_rental_count) AS mean_above_overall
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.rental_count > o.mean_rental_count
